title: 8 CI jobs exit 2 instantly
ticket: My script fans out 8 devin jobs to load-test our account. Every one exits with code 2 in under a second. Nothing in the logs.

commands.output:
#!/usr/bin/env bash
for i in $(seq 1 8); do
  devin --cwd ~/app --mode bypass-permissions --prompt "$PROMPT" > job$i.log 2>&1 &
done
wait

--permission-mode <PERMISSION_MODE>
          Permission mode
          
          Modes: "auto" auto-approves read-only tools, "accept-edits" also auto-approves workspace edits, "smart" additionally auto-runs actions a fast model judges safe, "dangerous" auto-approves all tools.
          
          [env: DEVIN_PERMISSION_MODE=]
          [default: auto]

  -p, --print [<PROMPT>]
          Print response and exit
          
          Runs in non-interactive mode: processes the prompt and exits. Optionally accepts an inline prompt: -p "fix the bug"

      --respect-workspace-trust [<RESPECT_WORKSPACE_TRUST>]
          Respect workspace trust settings
          
          Defaults to true in every mode. Non-interactive (print) mode cannot show the trust prompt and fails in an untrusted directory; pass --respect-workspace-trust false to skip the check.
          
          [possible values: true, false]

error: unexpected argument '--cwd' found

  tip: to pass '--cwd' as a value, use '-- --cwd'

Usage: devin [OPTIONS] [PATH]... [-- <PROMPT>...] [COMMAND]

For more information, try '--help'.
job1.log  job2.log  job3.log  job4.log  job5.log  job6.log  job7.log  job8.log  run.sh

choices: --cwd, --mode and --prompt are not Devin CLI flags
The account hit its message quota
8 concurrent sessions exceed the per-user limit

explain: Real repro (resource_exhausted ticket): invented flags from other tools. Exit 2 = arg parse error. Also detach stdin or jobs suspend on tty output.

title: Login on an SSH box fails
ticket: I'm on a remote dev box over SSH. I went to show-auth-code, copied the code, pasted it into devin auth login and it says 'Failed to exchange code'.

commands.output:
Not logged in.
  Credentials path: /home/customer/.local/share/devin/credentials.toml
Run `devin auth login` to authenticate.

Log in to Devin

Usage: devin auth login [OPTIONS]

Options:
      --force-manual-token-flow
          Skip browser-based auth and paste a token manually
          
          Useful for remote or SSH sessions where the localhost redirect won't work.

  -h, --help
          Print help (see a summary with '-h')

choices: The code came from the Desktop backup flow; CLI login is PKCE and needs the code from its own printed link
Remote boxes can't log in to the CLI
The code expired because SSH is slow
devin auth login --force-manual-token-flow, open the printed link, paste that code
Use Provide Devin auth token (backup login)

explain: Hit for real in the Master Devin CLI session: show-auth-code codes are Desktop-only; CLI codes come from its PKCE link.

title: Windows command never finishes
ticket: Devin Local on Windows 11 runs `mvn test-compile -q` and it stays 'in progress' forever. Same command finishes in my terminal.

choices: ACP spawns bash.exe -c from PATH and MKS Toolkit bash comes first
Maven is too slow for Devin
Put Git Bash ahead of MKS on PATH (or remove MKS from PATH) and retest; collect ACP logs if it persists

explain: Generalized from a real case. Did NOT reproduce with Git Bash; MKS is the leading suspect, unconfirmed. Label it that way to the customer.

title: Workspace disappears, two windows next launch
ticket: I open my saved .code-workspace, start a Devin Local chat, and the title changes to 'Untitled (Workspace)'. Next time I open Devin I get two windows.

choices: Sending the first Devin Local message (chat init)
Escalate with renderer.log 'Workspace transition' lines + repro steps; workaround: reopen the saved workspace

explain: Generalized from a real case, reproduced 2/2. Trigger confirmed; internal mechanism not confirmed from source. The 'recorded' log line is from the real repro (ids truncated there).
